label: copy-phase input v, mostly at original positions 2-3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input token is v (99.3% of activation mass; a small residue on input t). It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or when v is first seen. Within copy-phase v inputs it is selective: it fires on about 21% of them, concentrated at recall_idx 3-4 (v was original token 2 or 3), and weaker or absent near the end of the sequence (to_go 0-1) and at short L. Magnitude is highest when the next output is t (precision 0.99 for v at recall 3-4 followed by out t); the top examples are all v followed by t. Copy-phase input v alone gives mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.21; restricting to recall_idx 3-4 gives dev F1 0.60 and mass recall 0.85.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: v, t, k, u, -, 3; least: s, 1, a, x) and the token being output (most: t, v, 3, j, k, p; least: h, f, -, 0); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=13.
